historikk.lede: Strategy ke apne Myfxbook record se — Tag Markets ka ek aam account, 1:500 — 3 November 2024 se 14 October 2026 tak. Har bar ek mahine ka nafa hai; us ke neeche ka nishan us mahine ki sab se badi kami hai. Jo 30 % fee aap ada karte hain, woh in adaad mein se nahi kaati gayi. Purane nataij, koi peshgoi nahi.
notes: 24 mahinon mein ek bhi nuqsan wala mahina nahi — is ka matlab yeh bhi hai keh yeh record abhi aise mahine se guzra hi nahi.

Nuqsan wale din aate hain: rozana ki 427 readings mein se 49. Sab se bura, 3 June 2025 ko −0.64 %, 24× par ek din mein aap ke deposit ka taqreeban −15 % hai; sab se gehri kami, −0.86 %, taqreeban −21 %.
Ausat nuqsan ($134.97) ausat nafe ($93.37) se bada hai. Nateeja jeet ki oonchi sharah ki wajah se achha hai, is liye lagataar nuqsanaat mein jitna jaata hai, lagataar jeet mein utna wapas nahi aata.
Account 5 % par band hota hai. Record ki sab se gehri kami, 0.86 %, us faasle ka taqreeban chhata hissa hai.

Yahan kami har din ke closing balance par naapi gayi hai; din ke andar woh aur gehri ho sakti hai. Record mein gaps hain — sab se lamba 20 August se 12 September 2025 tak hai — aur har gap ko ek hi reading gina jaata hai.

CopyX ke andar strategy card par 0.26 % ke saath «Max DD» ka label laga hai. AiTech ke presentation ki ek slide 0.26 % ko ausat drawdown (kami) aur 0.86 % ko sab se gehri kehti hai. Myfxbook par sab se gehri kami 0.86 % hai, aur hum wohi istemal karte hain.

uttak.lede: Profit kisi bhi waqt nikal sakta hai; deposit pehli trade ke 30 din baad hi, aur use nikalne se account band ho jaata hai. Raste ke teen hisse hain, aur darmiyan wala sirf pehli baar chahiye. Shuru mein hi ek baar, chhoti raqam ke saath kar ke dekh lein, taakeh bharosa karne se pehle pata ho keh yeh chalta hai.

parts.tittel: Amplify se aap ke Tag wallet tak
parts.tekst: Dashboard par AMPLIFY kholein. Jo profit nikala ja sakta hai woh AVAILABLE mein dikhta hai. WITHDRAW dabayein, raqam likhein, phir WITHDRAW, aur phir CONTINUE. Back office is ki jaanch karta hai, is liye Tag Markets Wallet mein aane mein kuch waqt lag sakta hai — page refresh karein.

parts.tittel: Sirf pehli baar: apna wallet jodein
parts.tekst: TAG WALLET → YOUR CRYPTO WALLETS → ADD A CRYPTO WALLET kholein. Malik ka naam bharein, CRYPTO chunein, billing details aur apne wallet ka address daalein, dashboard ka login password likhein aur SUBMIT CRYPTO WALLET dabayein. Yeh PENDING VALIDATION dikhata hai — aam taur par 5 se 45 minute, zyada se zyada 24 ghante.

parts.tittel: Tag wallet se apne wallet tak
parts.tekst: TAG WALLET → WITHDRAWALS. Raqam likhein aur SUBMIT REQUEST dabayein, box par tick karein, «Your attention is required. Please click here» dabayein, verify kiya hua wallet daalein, aur CRYPTOCHILL chunein — is ke baghair withdrawal process nahi hoga aur phir se shuru karna padega. Details dekhein aur WITHDRAW dabayein.

uttak.facts: Broker ki kam az kam withdrawal had Ethereum (ETH), BNB (BSC) aur Bitcoin (BTC) par $10, aur Tron (TRX) par $50 hai. Network fee kaati jaati hai, jo network par munhasir hai — yaani jo pahunchta hai, woh taqreeban raqam mein se network fee kam kar ke hota hai. Broker ke mutabiq Amplify payouts mein 1–3 karobari din lagte hain, aur crypto withdrawals mein $999 tak ki raqam par 2–24 ghante, $4,999 tak ki raqam par zyada se zyada 48 ghante, aur us se zyada raqam par zyada se zyada 72 ghante lagte hain. CopyX mein profit ko Follower Hub, Strategies, Withdraw se bhi nikala ja sakta hai; phir woh aap ke Tag Markets wallet mein pahunch jaata hai. Withdrawal pehle usi tareeqe par wapas jata hai jis se aap ne deposit kiya tha, sab se naya deposit pehle — agar aap ne card se deposit kiya tha to withdrawal pehle card par jata hai.

items.q: Kya yeh dhoka hai?
items.a:
Sawal jaaiz hai, aur paise se judi har cheez ke baare mein poochna chahiye.

Jo aap khud jaanch sakte hain: aap ka paisa broker ke paas rehta hai, kabhi Aimpire ya aap ke sponsor ke paas nahi; profit jab aap kahein nikala ja sakta hai; aur is safhe ke usool broker aur platform ke apne safhaat se naqal kiye gaye hain.

Is liye sirf utna hi daalein jise poora khona aap bardasht kar sakein. Koi yeh waada nahi kar sakta keh strategy kamati rahegi.

Khud jaanchein: Myfxbook par history dekhein (Sonic → Record mein), aur shuru mein thori raqam nikaal kar dekhein — taake mazeed daalne se pehle aap jaan lein keh withdrawal kaam karta hai.

items.q: Kya yeh halal hai?
items.a:
Yeh faisla aap ka hai — ulama trading ko mukhtalif nazar se dekhte hain. Amli taur par yeh aise hai:

⏱️ Ek trade ausatan taqreeban 4 ghante chalti hai — Sonic din ke andar trade karti hai.
🚫 Myfxbook par strategy account mein sood (swap) $0 dikhaya gaya hai.
🕌 Broker ke paas Islami account bhi hai, swap ke baghair.
🧾 Chhoti fees aati hain, jaise fi lot commission. Yeh fees hain, sood nahi.

items.q: Mera paisa kis ke paas rehta hai?
items.a: Broker, yaani Tag Markets ke paas — na Aimpire ke paas, na aap ke sponsor ke. Kisi shakhs ko kabhi paisa na bhejein, aur sirf apne portal ke andar se jama karein.

items.q: Shuru karne ke liye kitna chahiye?
items.a: Kam az kam $10, deposit ke liye bhi aur Sonic se judne ke liye bhi. Utni raqam se shuru karein jise poora khona aap bardasht kar sakein, aur zyada ka faisla karne se pehle chand hafte dekhein. Note: fees katne ke baad $10 pahunchne chahiyein, is liye thora zyada bhejein.

items.q: Kya mere mulk mein is ki ijazat hai?
items.a:
Har mulk ke usool alag hain aur badalte rehte hain, is liye jama karne se pehle apne mulk ke usool dekh lein — hum qanooni mashwara nahi de sakte. Do alag baatein aham hain.

Broker ki apni fehrist: broker apni website par ek taaza fehrist shaye karta hai keh woh kahan kaam karta hai. Yeh fehrist badal sakti hai, is liye register karne se pehle use wahin ja kar khud parhein — kisi ke khulase par bharosa na karein, hamare par bhi nahi.

Aap ke apne mulk ke usool: yeh aap ke baare mein hain, broker ke baare mein nahi. Dekhein keh aap ke mulk ka markazi bank ya maliyati idara trading ke liye beroon-e-mulk paisa bhejne ke baare mein kya kehta hai, aur yaqeen na ho to apne bank se poochh lein. Pakistan mein yeh State Bank ke EPD Circular Letter No. 08 of 2022 mein likha hai — jama karne se pehle use parh lein. Broker ki fehrist is baare mein kuch nahi kehti.

items.q: Mujhe kaun si apps chahiyein?
items.a: Do, dono muft: apna account dekhne ke liye MetaTrader 5, aur Aimpire group ke liye Element X. Sirf official stores se install karein. Tag Markets aur CopyX browser mein chalte hain.

items.q: Approval mein kitna waqt lagta hai?
items.a: Broker ke mutabiq verification «just takes a few minutes» (yaani bas chand minute leti hai), zyada rush ya adhoori dastavezaat par der ho sakti hai. Aap ko ek ID document aur face scan chahiye. Reject ho jaaye to wajah SumSub ki email mein aati hai. Intezar ka waqt step 6, yaani apps ke liye istemal karein.

items.q: Mere liye 24× ka kya matlab hai?
items.a: Aimpire token ke saath aap ka paisa 24 guna bada trade karta hai: hamare apne test mein $109 se $2,616 ka trading balance bana. Nafa aur nuqsan dono 24 guna bade. Us balance mein 4.2 % ki kami aap ka poora deposit hai, aur account 5 % par band ho jaata hai.

items.q: Is ki qeemat kya hai?
items.a: Sonic strategy profit par 30 % performance fee leti hai, yaani profit ka taqreeban 70 % aap ka — yeh kam kyun ho sakta hai, yeh Amplify wale hisse mein bataya gaya hai. Na koi management fee hai na joining fee. Amplify accounts par broker is ke ilawa forex aur metals par $10 fi lot commission leta hai. Phir woh laagatein hain jo har trade mein hoti hain: spread, raat bhar khuli rakhi gayi positions par swap, aur crypto jama karane ya nikalne par network fees.

items.q: Kya main apna paisa nikal sakta hoon?
items.a: Profit: haan, kisi bhi waqt, kisi bhi din. Aap ka deposit: pehli trade ke 30 din baad hi, aur use nikalte hi account fauran band ho jaata hai. Upgrade se woh 30 din phir se shuru hote hain. Broker ke mutabiq payout mein 1–3 karobari din lagte hain. Steps «Sonic» → «Withdrawal» mein hain.

items.q: Kya main apna profit dobara invest kar sakta hoon?
items.a: Haan. CopyX mein Follower Hub kholein, phir Strategies, strategy par Reinvest dabayein, raqam daalein aur Upgrade dabayein. Pehle yeh jaan lein: broker ke mutabiq upgrade se woh 30 din phir se shuru ho jaate hain jin ke baad hi aap ka deposit nikala ja sakta hai.

items.q: Kya rozana nuqsan ki koi had hai?
items.a: Rozana ki koi had nahi. Ek kul had hai: starting balance ka 10 %, ya Aimpire token ke saath 5 %. Wahan pahunchte hi account khud ba khud band ho jaata hai.

items.q: Kya profit ki zamanat hai?
items.a: Nahi. Yahan kisi cheez ki zamanat nahi. Shaye shuda nataij — Myfxbook bhi — strategy ke apne account ke purane nataij hain, us fee ke baghair jo aap ada karte hain — koi peshgoi nahi.

items.q: Mujhe kaise pata chalega keh token ne kaam kiya?
items.a: MetaTrader 5 mein balance dekhein: token ke saath woh aap ki daali hui raqam ka 24 guna hota hai. Agar nahi hai to ruk jaayein aur kuch bhi karne se pehle apne sponsor se poochein.

items.q: Koi kehta hai keh 24× ke liye mujhe eCredits chahiyein, ya crypto bhejna hoga.
items.a:
Aimpire ke zariye nahi. Hamara token #Aitech hai, code 000000 ke saath, aur is ke liye aap kuch nahi bhejte. Platform par «#eCredits» wala ek rasta bhi hai: us mein aap jitni raqam invest karte hain, utne hi eCredits ek wallet address par bhejte hain, yaani $100 ka matlab hai aap ke deposit ke ilawa 100 eCredits.

Agar koi aap se apne deposit page ke ilawa kahin aur paise ya crypto bhejne ko kahe to ruk jaayein aur apne sponsor se poochein.

items.q: Kya mere ek se zyada accounts ho sakte hain?
items.a: Haan. Broker kehta hai keh aap jitne chahein rakh sakte hain, basharte har account usoolon par chale.

items.q: Mera deposit nahi pahuncha.
items.a: Pehle apne wallet mein transaction dekhein — portal woh paisa nahi dikha sakta jo us tak pahuncha hi nahi. Aap ke wallet ka apna andaza 24 ghante tak ka ho sakta hai. Us ke baad apne sponsor ko transaction ID bhejein, kabhi apne login ka screenshot nahi.

items.q: Main ne ghalat network chun liya.
items.a: Ghalat network ka matlab yeh ho sakta hai keh paisa kabhi pahunche hi nahi — wallets «permanent loss of funds» se khabardar karte hain. Fauran apne wallet ki support se transaction ID ke saath raabta karein. Aimpire mein koi bhi crypto transfer wapas nahi kar sakta.

items.q: Koi khud ko support bata kar mera password maang raha hai.
items.a: Na dein — na support ko, na kisi leader ko, na kisi aur ko. Aimpire kabhi nahi maangega. Kisi ko aap ke nataij dekhne hon to use Investor Password dein: us se sirf dekha ja sakta hai, trade nahi.

items.q: Main password bhool gaya.
items.a: Broker ke paas use badalne ki apni guide hai, «Shuru karein» → «Pehle se mojood rehnumai» mein. Chat mein kisi se kabhi reset karne ko na kahein.

items.q: Kya mujhe doosron ko bulana zaroori hai?
items.a: Nahi. Aap account khol sakte hain, Sonic ko chalne de sakte hain, aur kisi ko bhi jode baghair yeh sab kar sakte hain. Introducing broker ban kar kamana ikhtiyari hai, aur platform par kuch bhi is ka taqaza nahi karta.

items.q: Tax ke liye apna statement kaise nikaloon?
items.a: Windows computer par MetaTrader 5 ka terminal ise export kar sakta hai: neeche History tab kholein, right-click karein, Export chunein aur ise HTML ke taur par save karein, phir use PDF mein print karein. Har deposit aur har withdrawal ki raseedein bhi sambhal kar rakhein. Usool aap ke mulk par munhasir hain, aur hum tax ke baare mein mashwara nahi de sakte.

items.q: Madad kahan milegi?
items.a: Pehle yeh safha. Phir account se judi har baat ke liye aap ka sponsor — jis ne aap ko bulaya. Agar paisa na pahunche ya kuch ghalat lage to aap ka sponsor baat aage pahunchata hai. Aur Aimpire group mein poochein: aksar kisi aur ka bhi yahi sawal raha hota hai.

items.q: Market sab se zyada kab hilti hai?
items.a: Tay shuda news ke aas paas. Economic calendar har release par mutawaqqa asar dikhata hai, aur sab se mazboot — jaise interest rate ke faisle — High ke nishan ke saath aate hain. High release ke aas paas ke minuton mein qeematen dono taraf tezi se hil sakti hain, aur spread aksar chaura ho jata hai. Bohat se log High release se pehle aur baad ke taqreeban 15 minute ruk kar hi kuch jaanchte hain. Khayal rahe: calendar feed mein New York ka waqt hota hai, is liye ise apni ghari se milayein. Calendar aap ko Tools mein mile ga.

items.q: Mujhe page ka purana version nazar aa raha hai
items.a: Agar upar koi button kahe keh naya version tayyar hai to use dabayein. Warna browser mein Aimpire ke saare tabs band karein aur apne sponsor ke message se link dobara kholein. Phir bhi purana page? Use ek baar reload karein — phone par page ko neeche ki taraf khainchein. Aakhri jaanch ke liye aap link ko private window mein khol sakte hain (Chrome: Incognito, Safari: Private), lekin private window band karte hi aap ka sponsor aur aap ki progress bhool jaati hai.

inntekt.intro: Ikhtiyari. Kamaai ke chaar raste, aur ek warning: aap ke asal adaad o shumar sirf aap ke IB Portal mein hote hain — kisi chat mein nahi.
items: Aap ki team ke har lot par trading cost ka ek hissa wapas aata hai. Yeh sargarmi par milta hai, waadon par nahi — trading nahi to rebate nahi.
Jab koi strategy nafa ke saath trade band karti hai to profit taqseem hota hai. Sab se bara hissa us ka rehta hai jis ka paisa account mein hai.

Jin logon ko aap laaye hain, jaise jaise woh trading shuru karte hain, structure ke mazeed levels khul sakte hain. Aap ke IB Portal mein dikhta hai keh kaun se levels khul chuke hain aur kaun se abhi lock hain — asal adaad wohi hain jo us screen par hain.
Leader pools aur kuch arsay ke liye chalne wali campaigns aati jati rehti hain. Is liye in par bharosa karne se pehle IB Portal mein mojooda sharait zaroor parh lein.
inntekt.warning: Trading mein asal khatra hota hai, aur zyada tar retail accounts nuqsan mein rehte hain. Yahan aap ki kamaai is par hai keh asal mein kitni trading hoti hai — kisi aamdani ki zamanat nahi, aur yeh sifar bhi ho sakti hai. Hum chahte hain keh aap yeh shuru hi se saaf jaan lein.

ib.lede: Yeh hissa ikhtiyari hai. Aap account khol sakte hain, Sonic ko chalne de sakte hain, aur kisi ek shakhs ko bhi bulaye baghair yeh sab kar sakte hain. Platform par aisa koi taqaza nahi. Yeh yahan is liye hai keh log poochte hain keh kaam kaise hota hai — aur is liye keh jab paise ki baat aadhi adhoori samjhai jaaye to community isi se bigadti hai.

blocks.tekst: Broker har trade par spread aur commission pehle se leta hai, chahe aap ne kisi ko bulaya ho ya na. Introducing Broker ko broker ki kamaai ka ek hissa milta hai. Poori industry mein yahi aam nizaam hai, aur yeh us shakhs par koi alag fee nahi jise aap ne bulaya. Sonic par ek aur baat jaanna zaroori hai: aap se upar wale log jo kamate hain, us ka ek hissa member ki apni 30 % performance fee se aata hai. Fee dono soorton mein utni hi rehti hai, lekin use member hi ada karta hai.

Plan mein das generations hain. Woh shuru mein band hoti hain. Aap ka IB Portal do lines dikhata hai jo sab tay karti hain: «# of Directs with active Trading account» aur «Generations unlocked». Generations tabhi khulti hain jab aap ke directs — yaani woh log jinhein aap ne khud bulaya — ke active trading accounts hon. Tab tak level par mabni streams band levels par kuch nahi deteen. Yeh kaise khulti hain, Tag Markets ke us presentation ke mutabiq jise doosri teams istemal karti hain: khud aap ke kam az kam $250 trading mein hone chahiyein, jis se pehle teen levels khulte hain. Levels chaar se das, jaise jaise aap ke baraah-e-raast bulaye hue das tak logon mein se har ek ke $250 trading mein hon, waise waise khulte hain. Portal har level ki sharah nahi dikhata.

AiTech ke apne 3 October 2026 ke presentation mein programme ki do sooratein dikhayi gayi hain. Bain-ul-aqwami programme, jo Europe se bahar ke members ke liye hai, das levels par adaigi karta hai: har level par har trade ke profit ka 2.5 %, aur fi lot $2.00, $1.50, $1.00, $1.00 aur phir levels paanch se das par $0.50 — kul mila kar fi lot $8.50 tak. Europe wala programme sirf ek level par adaigi karta hai: 2.5 %, jo volume ke saath 22.5 % tak badh sakta hai; $2.00 fi lot, jo $6.50 tak badh sakta hai; aur ek general bonus — $2.00 fi lot aur ek bonus payment. CopyX app mein is general bonus ke darje $10,000, $50,000, $200,000 aur $500,000 ke team volume par hain.

Broker ka apna help centre apne amplified accounts ke liye ek teesra jadwal batata hai — teen levels par $3.00, $1.20 aur $0.60. Ho sakta hai yeh jadwal AiTech ke bajaye Tag Markets ke apne partner plan ka ho. Wohi help centre kehta hai keh koi trade commission ke liye tabhi gini jaati hai jab woh kam az kam 3 minute khuli rahe.

blocks.tittel: Bonus model kaise banaya gaya hai
blocks.tekst:
Presentation ise paanch hisson mein dikhata hai. Pehle har trade ke profit ki taqseem: 70 % member ke paas rehta hai, 5 % developers ko jaata hai, aur 25 % structure mein das levels neeche tak baanta jaata hai — yaani upar bataya gaya har level ka 2.5 %. Phir fi lot commission, $2.00 fi lot ki ambassador sharah wale leader pools, aap ke network mein jama hone wale naye paise par «CPA», aur incentives.

CPA aur pools ke liye presentation aur portal dikhate hain keh har darje ke liye kitna volume chahiye — dekhein «Nau streams, naam ke saath». Das levels mein se har ek kab khulta hai, yeh aap ke directs par munhasir hai, jaisa keh «Woh lock jise koi nahi samjhata» mein bataya gaya hai. Is mein se kisi par bhi bharosa karne se pehle apne sponsor se kahein keh IB Portal mein aap ko aap ke apne adaad dikhaye. Presentation mein programme ke liye likha hai «subject to local restrictions» aur «only available to professional Influencer».

blocks.tittel: Asal sizes ke saath ek hisaab
blocks.tekst:
Farz karein bees members mein se har ek $100 jama karata hai. 24× par har ek $2,400 ke account ki tarah trade karta hai. Strategy ke apne volume ko copy karte hue — taqreeban $130,000 par mahine mein taqreeban 4.5 lots — aise bees accounts mil kar mahine mein taqreeban 1.7 lots trade karte hain. Pehle level par $2.00 fi lot ke hisaab se yeh mahine mein taqreeban $3.30 bante hain, aur woh bhi tabhi jab woh level khula ho.

Volume strategy se aata hai aur is baat se keh aap ke members kitna jama karate hain, kisi aisi cheez se nahi jo aap ke ikhtiyar mein ho. Apni team ke liye hisaab lagayein, kisi ke screenshot wale adad par nahi.

blocks.tittel: Formula, taakeh aap apne adaad daal sakein
blocks.tekst: Mahana rebate ≈ members × har ek ki trades × lots fi trade × sharah fi lot. In chaaron cheezon ko aap khud jaanch sakte hain: lot size aap ki leverage par munhasir hai, aur sharah is par keh aap ki agreement kis programme ke tehat hai. Apne adaad daalein, aur jawab aap ka hoga, kisi aur ka daawa nahi.

Taakeh aap unhein portal mein pehchanein, kisi chat mein nahi: Lot Commissions, Profit Share, CPA Earnings, Leader Pool 1 aur 2, Sonic Pool, Profit Pool, NeoFX Pool aur Super Sonic Bonus. «CPA Earnings» fi shakhs ke hisaab se nahi milti. Yeh us naye paise ka mahana feesad hai jo aap ki poori team jama karati hai — $10,000 par 1 % se le kar $100,000,000 par 7.5 % tak. Ise ek «50% rule» lagane ke baad gina jaata hai, yaani aadhe se zyada hissa aap ki sab se mazboot line se nahi aa sakta, aur adaigi farq ki soorat mein hoti hai, un sab ke muqable mein jo aap ke neeche khud bhi qualify karte hain. Presentation ki ek overview slide ise har qualified registration par milne wali adaigi batati hai; portal aur presentation ka apna jadwal ise deposits ke feesad ke taur par dikhate hain. Leader Pool 1 ki shuruaat $500,000 ke team volume se hoti hai, Leader Pool 2 ki $1,000,000 se. Adaigi USDT mein hoti hai.

Kisi aamdani ki zamanat nahi aur woh sifar bhi ho sakti hai. Upar sab kuch is par munhasir hai keh doosre paise jama karayein aur trade karein, jo is par munhasir hai keh woh aisa chunein — aur woh aap ke ikhtiyar mein nahi. Ise aisi sargarmi ka hissa samjhein jo shayad ho, kisi plan ki tarah nahi.

items.tittel: Sonic kya hai, aur faisla aap ka
items.tekst:
Sonic woh strategy hai jise aap ka account copy karta hai: us ki trades aap ke account mein khud ba khud chalti hain. Yeh sirf amplified chalti hai, Amplify par — shuru karne ke liye is ka koi chhota roop nahi. Is liye jo intekhab aap ko bachata hai, woh raqam hai.

Kam daalein agar in mein se koi baat sach ho: saari raqam chali jaaye to aap ke mahine ka budget bigad jaayega; aap ne kabhi kisi trade ko apne khilaaf jaate nahi dekha; yeh aap ka pehla trading account hai.

Utni raqam se shuru karein jise poora khona aap bardasht kar sakein, aur chand hafte dekhein. Baad mein badhayein to yaad rakhein: upgrade se aap ke deposit ki 30 din wali ginti phir se shuru ho jaati hai.

items.tittel: Amplify: aap apne deposit ke kai guna se trade karte hain
items.tekst:
Amplify ek funded account hai: aap jitna daalte hain, us ke kai guna se trade karte hain, aur paisa asli hai. Broker ka standard 12× hai; Aimpire token ke saath yeh 24× hai.

Hamare apne test mein $109 se $2,616 ka trading balance bana. Yeh guna nuqsan par bhi bilkul utna hi lagta hai jitna nafe par.

items.tittel: Account kab band hota hai, platform ke apne alfaaz mein
items.tekst:
«If the manager loses more than 10% of starting balance, your account will be liquidated.»

Token ke saath form yeh jodta hai: «By using a token code, your Amplify account draw down limit will change to 5% of your starting balance.»

Paison mein: aap ke $109 par $2,616 ki trading hoti hai. Us balance mein 1 ÷ 24 = 4.2 % ki kami aap ke poore $109 ke barabar hai — 5 % wali had tak pahunchne se bhi pehle. Yeh had seedha trigger hai: account khud ba khud band ho jaata hai, qeematon ke wapas aane ka koi intezar nahi. Isi liye sab se aham cheez raqam hai.

Community token ka khana woh jagah hai jahan Aimpire ka token daala jaata hai. #Aitech likhein, Verify dabayein, phir aane wale Hash khane mein 000000 likhein. Durust token ke baghair account 12× par 10 % wali had ke saath khulta hai, 24× par 5 % wali had ke saath nahi. Copy Now dabane se pehle dekh lein keh tick ka nishan nazar aa raha hai.

items.tittel: Zimmedari ke baare mein platform khud kya kehta hai
items.tekst:
Submit se pehle aap ek box par tick karte hain jis mein likha hai keh CopyX par trades woh traders karte hain jin ka Tag Markets se koi taalluq nahi, aur Tag Markets in trades ya un ke nataij ki koi zimmedari nahi leta.

Tick karne se pehle parh lein. Matlab yeh keh jo broker aap ka paisa rakhta hai, woh is ka jawabdeh nahi keh strategy us ka kya karti hai.

items.tittel: Jab faida ho, to aap ke paas kya bachta hai
items.tekst:
Presentation mein split 70 / 5 / 25 bataya gaya hai, aur saath «per trade» likha hai: profit ka 70 % aap ka, 5 % system chalane wale developers ka, 25 % us ka jise woh «the team» kehta hai — «Bonus model kaise banaya gaya hai» mein woh hissa dikhaya gaya hai. Sonic ke card par yeh 30 % performance fee ki soorat mein nazar aata hai, na koi management fee hai, na joining fee.

Yaani $100 ke profit mein se taqreeban $70 aap ke — aur kam, agar fee net nateeje ke bajaye har jeetne wali trade par katti hai. Card par «Schedule 1 Week» likha hai, magar yeh nahi keh fee har trade par gini jaati hai ya hafte ke net nateeje par. Apne sponsor se poochein.

Myfxbook samet published nataij strategy ka apna account dikhate hain. 30 % fee followers se li jaati hai, is liye woh un curves mein se nahi kaati gayi.

items.tekst:
Nafa kisi bhi waqt, kisi bhi ghari, kisi bhi din nikala ja sakta hai; broker ke mutabiq us ke baad adaigi mein 1–3 karobari din lagte hain.

Aap ki jama karayi raqam pehli trade ke 30 din baad hi nikal sakti hai — raqam daalne ke 30 din baad nahi — aur use nikalte hi account fauran band ho jaata hai. Account upgrade karne se woh 30 din dobara shuru ho jaate hain.

Rozana nuqsan ki koi had nahi, sirf 10 % wali (community token ke saath 5 %), aur aise jitne chahein account rakh sakte hain.

items.tittel: Commission aur leverage, aap ke apne paise ke hisaab se
items.tekst:
Amplified account mein forex aur metals (dhaatein) par commission $10 fi lot hai, jo trade band hone par lagti hai. Indices aur crypto ke liye broker ke apne help articles do mukhtalif jawab dete hain: ek kehta hai har cheez par $10 fi lot, doosra kehta hai indices par $1 aur crypto par kuch nahi.

Form par leverage 1:30 likhi hai, lekin yeh badhe hue balance par lagti hai. Aap ke apne deposit ke hisaab se dekhein to 24 × 30 = 720:1 — yaani aam account ke 1:500 se zyada, kam nahi. 12× par yeh 360:1 hai.

Apni pasand ka payment tareeqa muntakhib karein. Misaal ke taur par, agar merchant support karta ho to aap Easypaisa ya JazzCash istemal kar sakte hain.
Binance aap ko aap ki raqam aur payment ke tareeqe ke mutabiq dastiyab merchants dikhayega.
Merchant ke reviews check karein
Merchant muntakhib karne se pehle is ke reviews aur ratings achi tarah check karein.
Is baat ko yaqeeni banayein keh merchant verified ho aur is ki transaction history achi ho.
Is ki mukammal shuda transactions ki tadaad aur order completion rate bhi check karein.
Merchant se rabta karein
Apni pasand ke verified merchant ko muntakhib karein.
Is ke chat option mein ja kar message karein aur poochein keh aaya woh is waqt dastiyab hai ya nahi.
Transaction aage barhane se pehle merchant ke jawab ka intezar karein.
Payment transfer karein
Merchant ki janib se dastiyabi ki tasdeeq ke baad, order mein di gayi account tafseelat ke mutabiq payment transfer karein.
Is baat ko yaqeeni banayein keh wusool kunindah ke account ka naam wohi ho jo Binance P2P order mein darj hai.
Sirf wohi payment tareeqa istemal karein jis par order mein ittefaq kiya gaya ho.
Agar aap P2P par naye hain to chhoti raqam se transaction shuru karein aur Binance ki muqarrar karda hudood aur qawaid par amal karein.
USDT ki transaction ki tasdeeq karein
Payment karne ke baad, order mein Paid ka option sirf usi waqt muntakhib karein jab aap waqai payment transfer kar chuke hon.
Merchant ki janib se USDT release karne ka intezar karein.
Jab USDT aap ke Binance account mein aa jaaye to check karein keh poori aur durust raqam mausool hui hai.
Aham hifazati ehtiyatein
Hamesha aise verified merchant ka intikhab karein jis ke reviews ache hon aur transaction history mazboot ho.
Agar account ka naam order mein di gayi tafseelat se mukhtalif ho to payment transfer na karein.
Agar aap USDT farokht kar rahe hain to apne account mein payment mausool hone ki khud tasdeeq kiye baghair kabhi bhi USDT release na karein.
Tamam guftagu aur transaction ki tafseelat Binance ke official P2P chat aur order system mein mehfooz rakhein.
Sirf verified badge dekh kar merchant par mukammal bharosa na karein; is ki transaction history bhi check karein aur Binance ki security guidelines par amal karein.
tekst.lede: Abhi USDT nahi hai? Yahan dekhein keh Binance P2P par ise mehfooz tareeqe se kaise khareedein — ek video, aur Aimpire ki apni marhala waar guide.

innhold.title: Kya yeh halal hai?
innhold.lede: Yeh faisla aap ka hai — ulama trading ko mukhtalif nazar se dekhte hain. Amli taur par yeh aise hai:
items: Ek trade kitni der chalti hai
Ek trade ausatan taqreeban 4 ghante chalti hai — Sonic din ke andar trade karti hai.
Myfxbook par strategy account mein sood (swap) $0 dikhaya gaya hai.
Broker ke paas Islami account bhi hai, swap ke baghair.
Chhoti fees aati hain, jaise fi lot commission. Yeh fees hain, sood nahi.

juridisk.legal:
Aimpire ek seekhne wali community hai. Hum broker nahi hain, hum deposit nahi lete, hum kisi ke paise nahi sambhalte, aur hum financial advice nahi dete.

Kisi dusre mulk ke broker ke sath trading ke qawaid har jagah ek jaise nahi hain, aur kuch mulkon mein woh mehdood hain. Paise dalne se pehle maloom kar lein ke aap jahan rehte hain wahan kya lagu hota hai — woh faisla, aur us ka nateeja, aap ka apna hai. Yahan ke leader wohi baante hain jo unhon ne seekha hai; woh mashwara nahi dete, aur kisi ke paise nahi sambhalte. Community mein jo kuch baanta jata hai — chart, misalein, signal — woh seekhne ke liye hai, taake aap khud parakhna seekhein; woh kabhi kharidne ya bechne ka mashwara nahi hai.

App ki qeematein gold-api.com se aati hain, aur indices aur currency pairs wali qatar TradingView ka embedded ticker hai. Jab woh load hota hai to request aap ke IP address ke sath TradingView ko jati hai — jaise har us website par jo aap kholte hain. Khabrein Forex Factory se aati hain.

juridisk.risk: Trading mein khatra hai aur aap apni lagai hui raqam kho sakte hain. Yahan kuch bhi financial advice nahi, aur kisi aamdani ka waada nahi. Sirf wohi raqam lagayein jis ka nuqsan aap seh sakein, aur apne mulk ke qawaneen dekhein.

sammenlign.title: Bank, fund ya Sonic — aamne saamne
sammenlign.lede: Paisa rakhne ki teen jagahein, aur teenon se wohi sawal. Sonic ka record teenon mein sab se zyada nafa dikhata hai, aur us ke 23 mahinon mein ek bhi nuqsan wala mahina nahi aaya — lekin itna chhota record koi waada nahi, aur teenon mein se Sonic hi woh wahid jagah hai jahan aap sab kuch kho sakte hain.

tekst.lede: Ek theek tareeqe mein bhi nuqsan ke lambe silsile aate hain. Number chunein aur 100-100 trades ke 1,000 random daur dekhein. Yeh paanse ka khel hai, paish goi nahi.

tekst.title: Sone ki aik trade kitna paisa rokti hai?
tekst.lede: Margin woh raqam hai jo broker trade khuli rehne tak alag rakhta hai. Dekhein sone ki aik trade kitna rokti hai — aur sone ki qeemat mein $1 ki tabdeeli aap ke liye kya maani rakhti hai. Yeh hisaab hai, mashwara nahi.

tekst.title: Fibonacci levels
tekst.lede: Bari harkat ke baad bohat se traders in levels ko dekhte hain. Top aur bottom likhein — yeh levels hisaab hain, signal nahi.
tekst.note: Yeh woh levels hain jin par bohat se log nazar rakhte hain, aisi jagahein nahi jahan qeemat ko laazmi palatna ho. Inhein seekhne ke liye istemal karein, kabhi khareedne ya bechne ke signal ki tarah nahi.

innhold: Khwab bara rakhein, phir us par kaam bhi karein. Sirf chahna shuruaat hai, inaam nahi.
Jo seekhein woh aage batayein — jo ghalat hua, woh bhi. Saath wale ko saath le kar chalein.
Mehnat aur maharat ki qadar hoti hai. Aap kahan se aaye, yeh tay nahi karta keh aap kya ban sakte hain.
Yeh mil kar hi banega, akele nahi. Har koi apna hai, aur har koi apna hissa daalta hai.
